purpose.summary: Batch program for bulk registration of hospital admission medical treatment actions (入院診療行為一括登録 - Nyuin Shinryo Koi Ikkatsu Toroku). Part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system, it reads work files of medical treatment activity data, validates them, and performs batch registration with error and confirmation list output.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

notable_features: Japanese-language comments and data literals (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Multiple COPY statements referencing domain-specific copybooks (CPWKSRYACT, CPPTINF, CPSRYACT, CPHKNCOMBI, etc.)
COPY with REPLACING for record prefix substitution
Large OCCURS tables (up to 600 entries for sort work area, 400 for link area)
Sequential file I/O with FILE STATUS checks
Error list and confirmation list output structures (LST-ERR-AREA, LST-PRT-AREA)
No COMP-3 usage despite being a financial/billing system
Unix file paths (/var/tmp/) indicating Linux deployment
131 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural design
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese character encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments and string literals to appear as mojibake. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system used in Japanese medical clinics. The truncated source shows only the first ~16KB of a 111KB file; the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not visible in the excerpt but its presence is confirmed by mechanical indicators.
